quote_caption_ru:
"And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched,

and not have suffered his house to be broken through. Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not." – Иисус Христос
quote_caption_en: "And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through. Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not." – Jesus Christ
script_ru: И это знайте, что если бы хозяин дома знал, в какой час придет вор, то бодрствовал бы и не допустил бы, чтобы дом его был сломлен. Будьте же готовы, ибо в час, когда не думаете, придет Сын Человеческий.
